info.title: MAME NX Reborn
info.author: Blaze414
info.details:
MAME NX Reborn is a standalone MAME2003-Plus arcade emulator for Nintendo Switch, built specifically for native Switch homebrew. It combines the MAME 0.78/MAME2003-Plus core with a Switch-specific operating system layer and native frontend, without requiring RetroArch or libretro at runtime.

Features include a game library with grid, compact and list views, search, favourites and recents; native save states; controller assignment; per-game controls; DIP switches; cheats; artwork support; performance management; thermal protection; frameskip; and Pearl and Midnight themes. The frontend also provides accessibility options including text scaling, high contrast, reduced motion, focus indicators, navigation sounds and vibration settings.

The project supports MAME2003-Plus-era arcade ROM sets and provides hardware-conscious memory and performance handling for Nintendo Switch. ROMs, BIOS files and other copyrighted game data are not included.

changelog:
### Version 1.1.0

This release significantly improves save-state reliability, interface readability and ROM management while adding a number of Switch-specific quality-of-life improvements.

#### Save states

Save states now correctly survive save/load on Midway DCS-based games, including Mortal Kombat, Mortal Kombat II, Mortal Kombat 3, Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3, NBA Jam and other T-unit/Wolf-unit titles.

Fixed several issues that could cause failed saves, corrupted restores, muted audio, looping machines or stalled CPUs after loading:

* Fixed TMS34010 state registration order and memory allocation.
* Added missing ADSP2105 and DCS sound-board state registration.
* Corrected DCS reset handling during state loads.
* Restored CPU scheduling/idle-loop recovery after loading.
* Re-armed the DCS sample timer after loading.
* Preserved additional protection, CMOS, serial PIC and I/O ASIC state.

Tested with Mortal Kombat romsets, including `umk3`.

Games that cannot safely serialize now report the reason by name on the States page instead of showing an empty state list.

#### Interface and accessibility

* Default interface text scale increased to 150% for improved readability on the Switch display.
* Fixed layout problems caused by scaled text across the clock, battery indicator, pause menu, settings page, artwork labels, accent bars and hint bar.
* Panels, rows, plates and hint areas now size themselves around their text content.
* Existing 100% layouts retain their previous positioning.
* Replaced nearest-row bitmap font scaling with bilinear sampling and a gamma coverage curve for smoother text at all sizes.
* Improved placeholder tile caption contrast in both Pearl and Midnight themes.
* Continued support for high contrast, reduced motion, focus indicators, navigation sounds and configurable vibration.

#### ROM housekeeping

Added **Settings → Game Library** tools to move or delete ROM sets identified as `GAME_NOT_WORKING`.

* Shows the number and estimated size of affected ROM sets before cleanup.
* Only targets confirmed `GAME_NOT_WORKING` romsets.
* Excludes BIOS containers and ROMs required through parent/clone dependencies.
* Leaves files matching no known driver untouched.
* Added **X** on the Game Information screen to delete an individual romset.
* Warns when deleting a parent romset will affect dependent games.

**Important:** ROM deletion is permanent. The recommended workflow is to use **Move BROKEN romsets aside** first, verify the contents of `roms/broken/`, confirm the library still works as expected, and then remove the folder from a PC.

The ROM cleanup functionality has **not yet undergone extensive real-world testing**. Use it with care and maintain backups of important ROM data.

#### Frontend

* Native Switch frontend with grid, compact and list library views.
* Added/maintained categories, sorting, search, favourites, recents and play statistics.
* Improved game information and compatibility reporting.
* Added Pearl and Midnight themes.
* Touch and controller navigation use the same interaction model.
* Persistent controller hints provide visible button guidance.
* Optional artwork support with local caching and explicit network downloads.

#### Native pause tools

* Native pause overlay with save/load states.
* DIP switch and cabinet controls.
* Cheats and per-game control remapping.
* Default control remapping.
* Analog settings.
* Neo Geo memory-card support.
* `history.dat` information.
* Artwork-layer controls.
* Reset, return-to-library and exit actions.

#### Controller support

* Player 1 and Player 2 controller assignment.
* Support for separately connected controllers including Pro Controller.
* Live controller input testing from the controller settings page.
* Improved player/controller state reporting when fewer controllers are connected.

#### Performance and Switch integration

* Per-driver performance cost tiers.
* Adaptive CPU boost and catch-up frameskip.
* Thermal backoff and recovery hysteresis.
* Memory-fit checks for restricted applet-mode heaps.
* Automatic 720p handheld and 1080p docked output.
* Configurable audio queue targets.
* Native Switch OSD for display, audio, input, timing and filesystem handling.

#### Upgrade from 1.0.0

* Added a version stamp to `settings.txt`.
* Existing installations are upgraded to 150% text size once on first launch; changing it afterwards does not reset it.
* Other existing settings are preserved.
* Save states created with 1.0.0 are **not compatible** with 1.1.0 because the state format and registrations have changed.
* State size and signature validation now occurs before loading to prevent incompatible states from corrupting the running machine.

#### General

* Continued standalone operation without RetroArch or libretro.
* Improved per-install data isolation for settings, artwork and save states.
* Improved error reporting for unsupported or non-serializable games.
* Various stability, compatibility, rendering and frontend improvements.
